'''Tervail Dura''' is [[Warder]] to [[Beonin Marinye]]. 

==Appearance==
He is a dark-haired [[Taraboner]], with a deep white scar across his jaw and a strong nose. He is "whipcord lean."

==History==
He was very young when Beonin bonded him, little more than a boy.  He is considered to be one of the best swordsmen in Tarabon. He has saved Beonin's life more than twenty times.

== Activities ==
He is part of the Warders that accompany Egwene and Beonin when they survey the area around [[Tar Valon]].{{ref/book|10|16}}

He accompanies Beonin back to Tar Valon. She sends him to an inn in the city and wait for her to return from the [[White Tower]].
